name: Funding Carry Drag
thesis: Cumulative funding paid over a week is the realised cost of holding the crowded side. When that cost is high but price has gone nowhere, longs are financing a position that is not working, and the resolution of that impatience is downward.
invalidation: Retire if worst-symbol out-of-sample profit factor stays below 1.0 over 30 trades, or if the mechanism's driving series stops being published.
